verdict.rationale: Copilot is built into GitHub.com with no install (docs-44, docs-97). It answers questions about your codebase (docs-56) and lets you explore repositories without leaving GitHub (docs-73). It also reviews changes with suggested edits you can apply in a couple of clicks (docs-25), and proposes fixes via Copilot Autofix (docs-5, docs-14). The cloud agent can research a repository and draft implementation plans (docs-48). Together these deliver AI-generated insights and suggestions grounded in the user's own repo data inside the product. missing for 10: evidence of AI insights over non-code data such as issues, projects or activity metrics, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the quality of these insights.
